title: ClientError missing #[non_exhaustive] on public error enum
description: error.rs: ClientError is a pub enum with no #[non_exhaustive]. The rusty-prompt rule: 'Missing #[non_exhaustive] on public error enums. Adding a variant later is a breaking change without it.' Adding any future error variant (RateLimit, Redirect, etc.) forces a semver bump. Add #[non_exhaustive] now while pre-1.0; existing exhaustive match in the test suite within this crate is unaffected, but external callers gain forward-compat.
